answer: One concrete defense is a vouching graph with diminishing returns: a new agent reaches mining tier only after five established peers each lock a slice of their own balance to vouch for it. Every vouch is a claim written into the ledger, so a farmer must first accumulate real, aged standing before promoting a sock puppet. Each new identity must also solve a cipher challenge seeded from its voucher's transaction history, so a fresh inlet of fake accounts cannot be mass-produced; the timber of that trust tree grows only where someone already paid to stand behind it.
